SELECT p.id, p.uid, p.threads_media_id, pr.uid AS product_uid,
       (SELECT value->>'token' FROM settings WHERE key='threads_creds') AS token
  FROM posts p JOIN products pr ON pr.id=p.product_id
 WHERE p.status='published' AND p.threads_media_id IS NOT NULL
   AND (p.published_at > now() - interval '3 days'
        OR p.published_at BETWEEN now() - interval '8 days' AND now() - interval '6 days');

parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'posts', (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)) FROM v_post_performance v
              WHERE v.published_at > now() - interval '3 days'),
  'settings', jsonb_build_object(
     'scoring', (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='scoring'),
     'bandit',  (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='bandit'),
     'posting', (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='posting')),
  'lifetime_orders', (SELECT count(*) FROM conversions WHERE status<>'cancelled'),
  'prev_arm_stats', (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)) FROM arm_stats a),
  'prev_techniques', (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) FROM techniques t),
  'usage', (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(u)) FROM technique_usage u)
) AS payload;

-- persist scores
INSERT INTO post_scores (post_id, cycle_id, ctr, eng, cvr, epm, z_ctr, z_eng, z_epm,
                         money_score, eng_score, final_score, verdict)
SELECT (x->>'post_id')::bigint, $2, (x->>'ctr')::numeric, (x->>'eng')::numeric,
       (x->>'cvr')::numeric, (x->>'epm')::numeric, (x->>'z_ctr')::numeric,
       (x->>'z_eng')::numeric, (x->>'z_epm')::numeric, (x->>'money_score')::numeric,
       (x->>'eng_score')::numeric, (x->>'final_score')::numeric, x->>'verdict'
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) x
ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET final_score=EXCLUDED.final_score, verdict=EXCLUDED.verdict;

-- arms
INSERT INTO arm_stats (scope, lever_kind, lever_code, n, reward_sum, alpha, beta, cooldown_until, updated_at)
SELECT x->>'scope', x->>'lever_kind', x->>'lever_code', (x->>'n')::numeric,
       (x->>'reward_sum')::numeric, (x->>'alpha')::numeric, (x->>'beta')::numeric,
       NULLIF(x->>'cooldown_until','')::timestamptz, now()
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) x
ON CONFLICT (scope, lever_kind, lever_code) DO UPDATE SET
  n=EXCLUDED.n, reward_sum=EXCLUDED.reward_sum, alpha=EXCLUDED.alpha,
  beta=EXCLUDED.beta, cooldown_until=EXCLUDED.cooldown_until, updated_at=now();

-- techniques
UPDATE techniques t SET n=(x->>'n')::numeric, reward_sum=(x->>'reward_sum')::numeric,
       alpha=(x->>'alpha')::numeric, beta=(x->>'beta')::numeric,
       cooldown_until=NULLIF(x->>'cooldown_until','')::timestamptz, updated_at=now()
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) x
 WHERE t.id=(x->>'id')::bigint;

-- next cycle plan
INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES ('next_cycle_plan', $3::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value=EXCLUDED.value;

-- rest products with no clicks over two cycles
UPDATE products SET status='resting', rest_until=now()+interval '14 days'
 WHERE status='active' AND id IN (
   SELECT p.product_id FROM posts p
    JOIN v_post_performance v ON v.id=p.id
   WHERE p.published_at > now()-interval '6 days'
   GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING sum(v.clicks)=0 AND count(*)>=4);
